The first plot illustrates the relationship between the variable α and the value of BEU, with α ranging from 0.1 to 0.9. The x-axis is labeled α and is on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled BEU and is on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The line in the plot is blue, with circular markers at each data point. The line starts at approximately 28.0 BEU at α 0.1, peaks at around 28.5 BEU at α 0.5, and then declines to about 28.1 BEU at α 0.9.

The second plot shows the relationship between the variable p and the value of BEU, with p ranging from 0.05 to 0.45. The x-axis is labeled p and is on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The y-axis is labeled BEU and is on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The line in the plot is blue, with circular markers at each data point. The line starts at approximately 28.3 BEU at p 0.05, rises to about 28.5 BEU at p 0.15, then slightly declines to around 28.4 BEU at p 0.25, and finally decreases to approximately 28.2 BEU at p 0.45.
